properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: BodyLength
properties.description: Casing length along the duct. 0 uses three times the duct size, at least 900 mm

properties.name: CasingGrowth
properties.description: How far the casing stands out from the duct all round (the acoustic lining). 0 uses a quarter of the duct size, at least 50 mm

properties.name: CollarLength
properties.description: Length of the inlet and outlet collars. 0 uses a quarter of the duct size

properties.name: LossMode
properties.description: How the loss is given: a coefficient K, or a fixed pressure drop from the maker's data

properties.name: LossCoefficient
properties.description: Pressure-loss coefficient K, referenced to the connecting duct's own velocity

properties.name: PressureDrop
properties.description: Pressure drop in Pa at the design flow, used when LossMode is Fixed pressure drop (a typical value: replace with the maker's data)
